jobs.occupation: Huxley Associates Belgium - Senior Consultant - AI - Enabled IT Risk & Resilience Initiatives
jobs.description:
Our client, a leading organisation in the insurance sector, is driving an ambitious AI-enabled IT transformation and is looking for a Senior AI IT Risk, Compliance & Operational Resilience Consultant to join our client's team on a 12‑month contract in central Brussels. You will work closely with IT, Data, Architecture, Digital Technologies & AI teams to strengthen governance, risk management, regulatory compliance, operational resilience and fraud prevention around AI, cloud and ICT services, with a strong focus on regulations such as the AI Act, DORA, GDPR and Cra.
Languages

• English: Fluent

• Dutch: Basic

• French: Basic

• IT Risk & IT Governance (10+ years) - Assess and manage ICT and AI risks, define frameworks and controls across complex IT environments

• Operational Risk & Compliance (10+ years) - Identify operational, cyber, regulatory, contractual and fraud risks and drive remediation plans

• Audit, Internal Control or Risk Management - Prepare and support internal/external audits and regulatory inspections with structured evidence

• Financial/Insurance Sector Experience - Apply industry-specific risk and compliance practices within a regulated environment

• Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint - Produce professional risk registers, dashboards, impact assessments and executive reporting

• AI & Generative AI Understanding - Evaluate risks linked to AI models, training data, LLMs and third‑party AI services

• European AI Act Knowledge - Interpret and translate AI Act obligations into practical governance and compliance measures

• Operational Resilience & Cybersecurity for AI - Strengthen resilience and security controls around AI-driven systems

• Cloud, Outsourcing & ICT Risks - Advise on critical supplier management, exit strategies and outsourced service risk

• DORA, GDPR & Third‑Party Frameworks - Align AI and ICT activities with EU regulatory requirements and supervisory expectations

• Collaboration with IT, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Data & Digital Teams - Work cross‑functionally to embed risk, compliance and resilience in Ai4it programmes

Already living in Belgium and looking for a stable logistics job?

Do you enjoy physical work? Do you have experience in a warehouse or logistics environment? And are you comfortable working in a cold environment? Then this could be your next long-term opportunity!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse worker, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electric pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Loading and unloading trucks
• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods
• Keeping the warehouse organised and safe
After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

You are a good fit if you:

• Have previous experience in warehouse or logistics
• Have experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT)
• Can work in a 2-shift system
• Aren't afraid of working in cold environments
• Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
Reach truck experience is a big plus but not required.

If you don't meet every requirement but have some warehouse experience and a strong work ethic, you can still apply!

 

IMPORTANT: this job is only available for people who:

• Already live in Belgium
• Have a valid Belgian address
• Have legal permission to work in Belgium
Housing, relocation and visa sponsorship are not available for this position.

You will be a member of our SEM/TEM team. This team is responsible for in-line and out-of-line released electron microscopy inspection.  As a TEM technician you ensure the smooth processing of the various TEM inspections, focusing on the quality of the inspection.

• Preferable you have a bachelor’s degree or associate degree (2-year program) in science (chemistry, biology, physics) or equal to experience.
• It would be a great plus if you have hands-on experience with automated metrology or SEM/TEM inspections in the semi-conductor industry.  
• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.

• You are prepared to work in a shift system (early/late/night and 1 weekend out of 4).

jobs.occupation: Huxley Associates Belgium - Cyber Security Program Manager
jobs.description:
Our client, a leading player in the banking sector, is seeking a Cyber Security Program Manager to drive their bank-wide cyber security strategy, with a specific focus on post-quantum cryptography and long-term cryptographic resilience. You will join our client's team as a strategic leader, defining and overseeing a high-impact portfolio of security initiatives, engaging senior stakeholders, and ensuring compliance with evolving regulations and cryptographic standards.
Interested?

If you are ready to shape the future of cyber security in banking and lead our client's transition to quantum-safe architectures, we would be pleased to receive your application.

• Cyber Security Strategy & Portfolio Management - Define the cyber security initiative strategy, translate it into a prioritized portfolio, and oversee cross-dependencies to deliver measurable business outcomes

• Roadmap Development & Execution - Develop long-term and short/medium-term roadmaps with clear priorities and budgets, then drive day-to-day delivery, removing impediments and ensuring adherence to master plans

• Post-Quantum Cryptography (Pqc) Knowledge - Apply strong Pqc fundamentals (e.g., lattice-based algorithms, hybrid encryption, NIST standardization) to guide cryptographic modernization and resilience

• Information Security Governance - Lead initiatives aligned with established security frameworks and risk management practices, ensuring compliance with group standards and external guidelines

• Stakeholder & Executive Engagement - Interact regularly with senior management and ExCo, aggregating input and translating complex topics like quantum risk and Pqc transition into clear, actionable memos

• Governance & Policy Contribution - Support policy improvements and the development of quantum-safe data security frameworks in collaboration with relevant teams

• Leadership & Communication - Drive success across disciplines, navigate technical uncertainty, and tailor messaging for both executives and technical teams

• Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills - Break down complex issues such as Pqc migration trade-offs, proactively addressing long-term cryptographic risks and immediate vulnerabilities

• Language Skills - French mandatory (fluent), with professional proficiency in English and Dutch

• Work Arrangement - Hybrid working model based in Brussels
